sources.title: CAO README
sources.locator: What CAO does; Prerequisites; Install CAO; First supervisor launch
sources.finding: Local cao-server starts provider CLIs in isolated terminal sessions and gives a supervisor tools to coordinate workers; twelve provider CLIs; install via uv from main or PyPI; Web UI at localhost:9889; Apache-2.0.

sources.title: CAO codebase guide
sources.locator: Runtime surfaces; Package map; Providers and terminal backends
sources.finding: cao CLI, FastAPI cao-server, in-session cao-mcp-server, external cao-ops-mcp-server, React web UI, MCP Apps, Rust TUI; tmux/herdr backends; SQLite state; optional OpenTelemetry.

sources.title: Control planes
sources.locator: Surfaces at a glance; Remote fleets; cao-ops-mcp server
sources.finding: Web UI, cao session shell CLI, cao-ops-mcp MCP tools, cao fleet/worker for remote fleets, outbound event plugins; all inbound surfaces use the HTTP API.

sources.title: Web UI guide
sources.locator: Starting the Web UI; Remote machine access; Features
sources.finding: Bundled React dashboard at localhost:9889: sessions, agent spawn, profiles, flows, settings, live terminals, status badges, inbox; remote use via SSH port forwarding or --host 0.0.0.0.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.locator: settings.json schema; Auth (auth) env-var only; Server; Terminal backend
sources.finding: Single settings.json with CLI>env>file>default precedence; auth is default-off with local-token or IdP JWT modes; spawn_mode and pane layouts; network and auth settings env-var only.

sources.title: Python package manifest
sources.finding: cli-agent-orchestrator 2.5.3, Apache-2.0, Python >=3.10; macOS and Linux classifiers only.

sources.title: Platform guard
sources.finding: Raises on Windows: supported macOS (arm64, x86_64) and Linux (x86_64); Windows must use WSL2 because orchestration uses tmux.

sources.title: Provider enumeration
sources.finding: kiro_cli, claude_code, codex, kimi_cli, copilot_cli, opencode_cli, hermes, cursor_cli, antigravity_cli, omp, grok_cli, mcode (MiniMax Code), plus a test mock.

sources.title: Agent profiles
sources.finding: Profiles select provider, model, role/allowedTools, MCP servers, provider launch config (claudeConfig effort/fallback model), init timeout; install --provider overrides.

sources.title: In-session MCP server
sources.locator: handoff, assign, send_message, complete_assignment, list_siblings, memory_*, workflow_*, report_outcome tools
sources.finding: Supervisor/worker tools: handoff (blocking with timeout, optional use_worktree), assign (async), send_message, complete_assignment, get_handoff_result, list_siblings, delete_terminal, memory and workflow tools.

sources.title: Worktree service
sources.finding: use_worktree on handoff/assign gives that worker its own git worktree and branch derived from the terminal ID; global flag and cleanup command not built.

sources.title: Terminal status model
sources.finding: Statuses unknown, idle, processing, completed, waiting_user_answer, error.

sources.title: Flows
sources.finding: Scheduled agent sessions defined as Markdown with cron schedule, agent profile and provider; cao-server must be running for schedules; manual run supported.

sources.title: Flow service
sources.finding: APScheduler cron trigger computes next run time inside cao-server.

sources.title: Workflows
sources.finding: Saved multi-step agent pipelines in Python with concurrent fan-out, durable journal and resume, step replay, optional plan approval.

sources.title: Plan approval gate
sources.finding: Opt-in, default-off gate refusing an unapproved script-tier workflow plan (403 when absent, 503 when store unavailable).

sources.title: Tool restrictions
sources.locator: Default Behavior; Three Controls; How Tool Restrictions Are Enforced
sources.finding: role/allowedTools/--yolo controls; default developer role; enforced through provider-native flags for Claude Code, Copilot and Grok, Kiro tools; prompt-level instructions for Kimi, MiniMax and Codex.

sources.title: Memory system
sources.locator: Capabilities; Memory Scopes; MCP Tools; Context Injection
sources.finding: Five scopes, markdown wiki store with SQLite index, memory_store/recall/forget MCP tools, CLI, BM25/recency search, automatic injection at session start.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: Reusable SKILL.md folders in a global store, lazily loaded by name/description, scoped to profiles.

sources.title: Event plugins
sources.finding: Python event plugins in cao-server are observers for session/terminal/message events (Discord, Slack example, audit, metrics); cannot block operations.

sources.title: Agent plugins
sources.finding: Portable Agent Plugins 1.0.0 packages of skills and MCP servers installed with cao plugin add; surfaces gated off by default behind CAO_AGENT_PLUGINS_ENABLED.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry deployment
sources.finding: OTel spans and metrics are off by default (OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=false enables) and export to a collector the operator configures.

sources.title: AG-UI event stream
sources.finding: Default-off SSE AG-UI stream of metadata-only fleet events with replay and optional auth.

sources.title: MCP Apps
sources.finding: Optional host-rendered fleet UI (dashboard, agent, event stream views) inside MCP App-capable hosts such as Claude Desktop and VS Code.

sources.title: HTTP API overview
sources.finding: Sessions/terminals, inbox, profiles, workflows, memory, flows routes and PTY WebSocket on localhost:9889; OpenAPI served by cao-server.

sources.title: Inbox delivery
sources.finding: send_message queues in SQLite and delivers by bracketed paste once the target is idle, with watchdog and reconciliation sweeps.

sources.title: Terminal lifecycle
sources.finding: Terminals occupy tmux windows and DB records; cleanup paths snapshot state; restore documented.

sources.title: Working directory support
sources.finding: CAO_ENABLE_WORKING_DIRECTORY opt-in lets handoff/assign set a validated working directory.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: GitHub advisories or AWS reporting; 48h acknowledge, 7-day assessment, 30-day target for critical issues; 1.x supported.

sources.title: Control planes: remote fleets
sources.finding: cao fleet/worker address a broker for agents in a cluster; EKS reference implementation under examples/cao-clusters/kubernetes/eks.

sources.title: Rust TUI
sources.finding: Rust terminal UI crate (cao tui) with guided flow, handoff and results panes.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: Unreleased section lists ephemeral agents (off by default), pane spawn mode, local-token auth, per-terminal model recording, security CI; no dated roadmap.

sources.title: Web UI source
sources.finding: React components: DashboardHome, AgentPanel, FlowsPanel, InboxPanel, MemoryPanel, WorkflowsPanel, ProfilesPanel, PluginsPanel, SettingsPanel, TerminalView, OutputViewer.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 1563 stars, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-16, homepage awslabs.github.io/cli-agent-orchestrator; latest release v2.5.3 (2026-10-08).

sources.title: Bounded search: native/mobile/editor clients
sources.locator: grep over src/, web/src, tui/src, docs, README, agent-plugin, skills for electron, tauri, dmg, msi, ipa, apk, ios, android, react native, vsix, vscode extension, jetbrains plugin
sources.finding: No desktop-app packaging, no iOS/Android app, no editor extension (only a "vsix" mention in workflow_spec_service.py unrelated to an extension).

sources.title: Bounded search: issue tracking
sources.locator: grep for linear, jira, github issues, issue tracker, backlog, kanban, ticket, epic, assignee across src/, web/src, tui/src, docs, skills
sources.finding: No issue/ticket entity or tracker import; matches are incidental words in provider/UI strings.

sources.title: Bounded search: pull request delivery
sources.locator: grep for gh pr create, create_pull_request, pull request, merge, deploy across src/, web/src, skills, docs
sources.finding: No product-owned PR creation, merge or deploy implementation; pull-request mentions are contributor skill text and design docs.

sources.title: Bounded search: roles and SSO
sources.locator: grep for rbac, saml, scim, organization role, membership, presence, co-prompt across src/, web/src, docs
sources.finding: No RBAC, SAML, SCIM, membership or presence; auth is a single local token or IdP JWT with cao:read/cao:write scopes.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend and usage
sources.locator: grep for token usage, usage_cost, cost tracking, spend, budget across src/, web/src, tui/src
sources.finding: No spend, budget or per-task cost implementation; terminal records keep model names only.

sources.title: Bounded search: event triggers
sources.locator: grep for webhook, github webhook, trigger endpoint, event trigger across src/ and docs
sources.finding: Only cron flows start work unattended; no inbound webhook or Git event trigger (event plugins are outbound).

sources.title: Bounded search: hosted CAO service
sources.locator: grep for hosted service, saas, sign up, subscription, pricing across README, docs, src
sources.finding: No hosted CAO service, account or pricing; the project is software installed by the user.

sources.title: Bounded search: review UI
sources.locator: grep for diff, patch, unified diff, review comment across web/src and tui/src
sources.finding: No diff or code-review view in the Web UI or TUI; review is the agent CLIs' own interface in the terminal.
